name: The black swans
alt: Two black swans with red bills stand beside a shaded pond.
introduction: A quieter moment by the water, and another side of life at Critter Creek.
story:
The pond is part of the ranch's story, too. The black swans have featured in Critter Creek's photographs and stories over the years.

Ask the team about the birds you might see when arranging your visit. Each day brings its own opportunities to observe and learn.
care: Every gift helps sustain the ranch's mission of continued care for its resident animals.
